messages:
Alex (Stratton_Bio): Hey team — we want to onboard a custom NER model trained on our clinical notes. Needs PHI-safe handling (HIPAA), on-prem/private deployment, and low-latency for 200rps burst. What do you need from us to start?

Maya (CSM): Thanks Alex — sounds good. Quick Qs: 1) model size (params) / framework 2) do you require inference-time redaction or just storage controls? 3) target SLA for p95 latency?

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Model is a finetuned 7B in PyTorch. We need inference-time redaction (mask PHI spans) + audit logs. Target p95 ~200ms for short docs (<=512 tokens). Also flag: renewal in 6 weeks — if onboarding slips there's a risk we'll push to a competitor. :)

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Noted. For on-prem Private we'll need: sample eval dataset (de-identified is fine for initial perf), a small set of labeled NER ground truth (200-500 examples), and an example inference pipeline. We can run local QA first.

Lina (Safety): Agreement: we need to review redaction strategy. Two options: 1) model-level masking (post-process NER spans) or 2) a rule-based pre-filter + model verifies. For HIPAA we want deterministic redaction for PHI categories and an audit trail. Also need to confirm if training data had PHI — that'll affect our recommendations.

Noah (Platform Eng): For Private deployment, rough infra ask: 2x A40s or 1x A100PE for 7B with 512 max_seq. If you want int8 quantization we can run validation but need sample inputs to check quality delta. Autoscaling for 200rps burst -> suggest pool with spare capacity + burst policy.

Alex (Stratton_Bio): We can provide a small labeled set and 1k unlabeled examples. Training data contained PHI; we'll provide DPA. We'll prefer int8 for cost. Audit logs required for all inference calls.

Maya (CSM): Timeline proposal: - Week 0: intake + NDA/DPA signoff - Week 1: safety review + sample eval ingestion - Week 2: private cluster prep + perf smoke test - Week 3: quality tuning + go/no-go. Can we accelerate any step?

Arjun (Solutions Eng): We can parallelize safety review and cluster prep if DPA is signed. Also I can run a quick eval locally today if you drop a small sample (<=50 anonymized items).

Lina (Safety): For redaction config, please include the PHI taxonomy you used. We'll produce a draft redaction policy. Also add a validation checklist: false-negative tolerance, redaction latency budget (<20ms extra).

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Dropping 50 samples now in S3 link: https://s3.redwood-sample/stratton/ner_samples.tar.gz (access shared). PHI taxonomy: name, DOB, MRN, address, phone, med_id.

DeployBot: Deployment request created: RB-4123. Assigned: Noah. ETA for first smoke: 3 business days if infra approved.

Noah (Platform Eng): I'll spin a dev cluster and run int8 accuracy pass. Arjun — can you drop the inference harness you use?

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Pasted quick harness snippet (Python):
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(private=True, endpoint='https://private.redwood.local')
resp = client.predict(model='stratton-7b-ner', inputs=[...], redact=True)
```
Use `redact=True` for post-process masking; we'll test pre-filter too.

Maya (CSM): Noted renewal risk — capturing this in account plan. Alex, if we meet Week 3 GO this should align with renewal. If we hit blockers, we'll propose a short-term hosted fallback to keep you running.

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Appreciate that. One more: can we get logging of redaction decisions per call (who/why) for auditing?

Lina (Safety): Yes — we require per-call metadata: model version, redaction ruleset id, span offsets, and a hash of the input. We'll draft log schema.

Maya (CSM): Next actions: 1) Alex to confirm DPA signature + drop labeled set (link received) 2) Arjun to run local eval on 50 samples (today) 3) Noah to provision dev cluster (3bd) 4) Lina to draft redaction policy (48h) 5) Maya to update account plan and renewal mitigation.

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Confirm DPA signed (uploaded). Labeled set link: https://s3.redwood-sample/stratton/ner_labeled_500.jsonl

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Running eval now — quick findings: int8 baseline drop ~0.9 F1 on spans for this sample, will run more.

Noah (Platform Eng): Dev cluster up: https://private.redwood.local/rb-4123. Ping me with credentials.

Maya (CSM): Thanks all — looping in Sales (private thread) about renewal options if we see any schedule risk. Alex — we'll keep you posted daily in this thread. :thumbsup:

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Great, thanks everyone.

Lina (Safety): Uploading draft redaction policy v0.1 to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/safety/stratton/redaction_v0.1.docx

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Eval update in 45m.

DeployBot: RB-4123 status: dev-cluster-ready -> validation in progress.

Noah (Platform Eng): Minor note — if you need sub-200ms p95 we may tune batching; provide token length distribution.

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Token distro: median 120, 95th 420. Will upload histogram.

Maya (CSM): Closing admin loop: recorded as 'high-priority onboarding' in QBR ops board and flagged renewal risk.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Eval done: int8 F1 drop narrowed to 0.4 after simple calibration. Sharing full report in a bit.

Alex (Stratton_Bio): Excellent. Thanks team — look forward to the report.
